a: absolute decoded input value on common integer grid
b: absolute decoded step on common integer grid
q_r: exact nonnegative quotient and remainder of magnitudes; no native rounded quotient
binade: power-of-two B with B<=a<2B for a>0; only a<2B needed in theorem
coefficient_capacity: q*m and (q+1)*m, and their negatives, have magnitude<2^53
normal_binary64_window: after multiplying grid unit, nonzero coefficients occupy positions no lower than -149 and no higher than156
native_arithmetic_connection: Exact a-r is q*b; adding/subtracting b gives adjacent magnitude multiple. Correctly rounded f64 results would preserve representable exact values.
